subject.title: fix: tighten processSchema offset/limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should the model-facing process tool intentionally reject fractional `offset` and `limit` values instead of preserving the existing floor-and-clamp behavior?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but this changes accepted tool-call inputs and therefore requires ownership of the compatibility tradeoff rather than an automated assumption.

options.title: Adopt the integer contract
options.body: Accept fractional rejection after the contributor supplies current-head production-path proof for integers, fractions, and negative normalization.

options.title: Preserve numeric normalization
options.body: Keep `Type.Number()` if fractional values are intentionally supported and continue normalizing them at runtime.

recommendation.title: Adopt the integer contract
recommendation.body: Accept fractional rejection after the contributor supplies current-head production-path proof for integers, fractions, and negative normalization.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent agent-tool and runtime history makes this the best available owner for the model-facing parameter-contract choice.
